title: FTX-12b Cloth self-contact and contact speed-ups

title: FTX-25 Further frankensim lifts (survey 2026-10-13)
description:
Remaining frankensim lifts found by the 2026-10-13 survey (frankensim 7b70bc9e; lift files with provenance, never depend on the workspace). Done already: sparse LDLT, jacobi_eigh, det (+ tan), exact orient2d/3d, the libm/powi lint (tests/no_platform_libm.rs), the stills renderer (ftx_drape::render, ftx render).

1. fs-topo/src/intersect.rs tri_tri_intersect (exact, coplanar and shared-feature cases decided) for the start/end intersection audit, replacing ftx-drape contact.rs segment_meets_triangle (which hands coplanar segments to the distance check). Low marginal value until self-contact audits need it (FTX-12b).
2. fs-ad dual.rs + gradcheck.rs (+ the Real trait) as an independent derivative oracle for KAT 1 (ftx's Jet is checked only against finite differences).
3. fs-rand philox.rs + Stream/StreamKey (not the CBC generator: pointer-width dependent) into ftx-core: seeds for RANSAC and bootstrap sigma (FTX-19), extra two-start perturbations (FTX-14).
4. fs-sparse precond.rs ilu0 + pcg (inexact Newton when the contact pattern changes; FTX-12b; benchmark before any claim).
5. fs-detaudit (staged trace, first divergent stage between native and wasm) for KAT 9 debugging; swap FNV for SHA-256.
6. fs-propcheck + metamorphic.rs (shrinking, replay, relations) for the gauntlet (FTX-24): validation/alteration invariants.
7. fs-rep-mesh halfedge/repair/winding + fs-topo manifold_certificate: refuse non-manifold or inward-wound bodies; fast winding test.
8. fit_tape: Marquardt scaling lambda*diag(J^T J) and logistic reparameterisation instead of clamping (fs-material visco.rs:856-905); fs-ascent wolfe/lbfgs/stop for FTX-21's larger fits.
Not in frankensim (write fresh): 2D polygon offset/union, constrained Delaunay (keep spade), image decoding beyond stored PNG, homography/RANSAC/ArUco, bundle adjustment.
